quality_check.description: A single vertical paper-cut style reference sheet showing layered cream and orchard-green torn paper, five palette swatches in green, amber, cream, slate blue, and honey, plus simplified cut-paper botanical and anatomical samples. Fibrous paper grain and irregular cut edges are visible throughout, with soft daylight, slate-blue fatigue accents, and restrained honey highlights on neural and body-signal motifs.
violations: Some anatomical samples use more drawn contour lines than the requested minimal-outline treatment.
The anatomical examples occupy a relatively large portion of the sheet, making it slightly more like a motif reference board than a pure texture-and-palette sample.
